entities.title: fix-network skill
entities.summary: The agent skill that tells a coding agent when and how to use the fix-network binary to diagnose and repair a Mac's network.
entities.purpose: Holds SKILL.md: its front matter says when the skill applies (no internet, failing DNS, captive portal, a VPN that is connected but the intranet unreachable, broken networking after sleep); its body gives the steps (read-only diagnosis first, relay each outcome as given, dry run, then repair with only the flags the diagnosis supports) and the rules the agent must keep.
boundaries: It holds instructions only, no code: everything it describes is done by the binary in macos/rust/fix-network.
It is listed in the repository's AGENTS.md under Skills.
